title: Atacama Desert - San Pedro
excerpt: Explore the driest desert in the world, geysers, salt flats and starry skies in northern Chile.
description:
Immerse yourself in the magic of the Atacama Desert. This tour will take you from the Tatio geysers at sunrise to the salt flats of Miscanti lagoon, passing through the Valley of the Moon at sunset.

A unique experience of extreme nature and Atacameño culture.
location: San Pedro de Atacama, Antofagasta Region
itinerary: Day 2: Valley of the Moon and Death (Sunset)
Day 3: Tatio Geyser excursion and Puritama Hot Springs
Day 4: Miscanti and Miñiques Lagoons - Return

title: Torres del Paine - Chilean Patagonia
excerpt: World-class trekking among imposing glaciers, turquoise lakes and Patagonian wildlife.
description:
The eighth wonder of the world awaits you. Hike the most famous trails in Chile, sail in front of Grey Glacier and sleep under the Torres del Paine.

Ideal for photography lovers, trekking and wild nature enthusiasts.
itinerary: Day 1: Transfer Puerto Natales to Torres del Paine
Day 2: Base Torres viewpoint trek (Full day)

title: Valparaíso & Viña del Mar - Pacific Gems
excerpt: Bohemian culture, historic elevators, artistic murals and the best beaches of the central coast.
description:
Discover Chile's cultural jewel. Explore the hills of Valparaíso on its famous elevators, visit Pablo Neruda's house in Isla Negra and relax on the sands of Reñaca.

A perfect trip to connect with history and the sea.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival and tour of Alegre and Concepción Hills
Day 2: Excursion to Isla Negra and El Quisco
Day 3: Viña del Mar Beach and Flower Clock - Return

title: Pucón and Villarrica Volcano
excerpt: Thermal adventure, climbing the northernmost active volcano in Patagonia and crystal clear waters.
description:
Pucón is the adventure capital of southern Chile. Climb Villarrica Volcano seeing active lava, relax in natural hot springs and sail on Villarrica Lake.

A must-see destination for summer and winter.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival and free afternoon downtown
